기준: docs/3d-asset-guide.md와 사용자 원본 화면. 컨셉은 사용자 승인이나 실제 기하 검증의 대체물이 아님.

modeling.cave: assets/models/environment/cave_entrance의 구릉 모델과 공용 치수. 채택 컨셉은 assets/source/architecture/cave-concept/original.png.
modeling.terrain: 모서리를 깎은 암반 선반·흙 사면의 실제 정점을 NativeTerrainForms로 표시/SOLID에 공유. 기존 상면·경사로의 높이는 유지하고 새 잔디10종의 월드 좌표 군락을 같은 2.56m로 혼합.
modeling.chapel: 실제 사용자 approved-game-reference.jpg를 직접 참고한 돌출 입구·두 박공·굵은 종탑. 창·문·세공은 생성형 전체 면 원화. 바닥0.28m·왼쪽3단 계단·L자 몸체를 표시와 물리에 공유.
modeling.fountain: 모든 정점·물줄기·source footprint 2배. 중심 유지, root scale 단위값.
modeling.walls: 2D 원본의 열린 원형 망루·양쪽 석조 흉벽·목재 바닥과 외측 아치 음각. 몸체 반경1.30m, 전망 바닥4.25m, 성가퀴 정상5.15m. 닫힌 원뿔 지붕은 사용하지 않는다. 상부 난간은 FortressPlan3D.crown_parts의 같은 부피로 제작/SOLID에 연결한다. 기존 화살창·돌 받침·8개 상부 통로·독립 문짝을 유지한다.
modeling.medieval_craft: 주택의 실제 폭 덧문·경첩·처마 사선 버팀·단조 문띠와 직업별 길드 문장, 예배당의 입구 등기구, 성문 탑 실제 외측 면에 붙는 숲 문장. 공통 풍화 참나무·무광 철을 기존 GLB 재질에 합치며 광원·텍스처·보행 충돌은 추가하지 않는다.
modeling.wall_footing: 실제 wall_footprints 분절을 최대16개 균일값으로 전달해 바닥에 폭이 달라지는 흙·쇄석·이끼를 혼합한다. 성문 포장을 비우며 추가 메시·충돌체는 없다.

open_corner_design.reference: 2D 성벽과 성문 원본의 열린 망루·돌 난간·목재 통로
open_corner_design.pivot: Y-up, world XZ ground, corner base at Y=0, metre units, no scale transform

wall_walk.collision: Shared SOLID triangles, separate from ground FLOOR

courtyards.rotation: nw/ne/sw +90° around Y, local +Z front→world +X; NPCs, native SOLID footprints, minimap and local paver/plant positions follow the same frame.
courtyards.path_edges: Broken outer grid vertices, tapered end cells and capsule-shaped soil wear; house4×6 and chapel4×8 pavers share their actual FLOOR polygons.
courtyards.npc_approach: Actual GLB door_approach end +0.15m for preserved houses, dedicated facility approach for traders; old far-forecourt pixels do not place residents under wall walks.
courtyards.plant_layers: Ground ivy has a .025–.115m curved mesh; upright .66m flower stems and .53m arched fern fronds use species-specific geometry and instance scale. Taller ferns are kept back from path edges.
courtyards.paving: Six original paving images share one cached Texture2DArray; GPU blocks/mip chains remain unchanged and the ground shader uses nine user samplers.
courtyards.lanes: Two shared 1.8m ground-level ribbon polygons connect northwest pavers and southeast/southwest pavers to the plaza. Village.map_roads owns the polygons; roads.json and the single signed-distance texture are baked from those exact paths. Existing native ground owns FLOOR.
courtyards.canopy: One explicit 1.5×2m elliptical planting island joins a tall existing dark_fir350 rear canopy, a220px oak middle canopy and dark .95–1.40-scale fern/ivy undergrowth. Source tree transforms, native trunk collision, source-exclusion checks, soil bed, native paver notch and minimap use the same plan. Actual accepted leaf vertices are tested relative to the reference hero; paired browser captures judge final architectural visibility.
courtyards.chest: The existing chapel-forecourt chest keeps its index, scale and contents and moves to the right roadside using the chapel plan chest_point.
courtyards.planting_island: Generic plaza/road exclusion is replaced only for the two exact planned island tree points by native body/step clearance, at least .85m fountain-boundary distance, existing solid/water/NPC/gate checks, and a real garden/stone notch. The native hero walks the fountain perimeter beside both trunks.
courtyards.chest_placement_order: Chest positions are resolved before tree placement; exclusions use their actual relocated positions, preserving saved chest IDs and scale.
